'''Survival capsules''' were emergency escape devices for ships that either were not equipped with standard [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] or for last second ejection from a ship.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Survival_capsules_open.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Ahsoka Tano emerge from their capsules on Felucia]]
Survival capsules were large enough to encompass a single occupant and the chair the capsule was attached to. They were made of a tough, yet flexible, material that allowed them to fall from great heights and come to a bouncing landing all while maintaining their structural integrity and protecting the occupant. They were yellow in color with "CAUTION - Explosive Extrusion" written in red on the sides. Once the capsules safely came to rest on a solid surface, the sides of the capsule would burst open to allow the passenger to exit the pod.<ref name="BH" />

==History==
During the Clone Wars, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to the [[Felucia system/Legends|Felucia system]] to investigate the lack of communication from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Felucia medical station/Legends|medical center]] stationed there. When they arrived at [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], they were attacked by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] who succeeded in damaging the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] unarmed [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]], forcing it to crash on the planet's surface. Just before the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] slammed into a rocky outcropping, they ejected, deploying their survival capsules and bouncing down the huge foliage that covered the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. All three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] capsules came to rest relatively close to each other and the three safely exited the pods.<ref name="BH" />
